notes: Every occasion the app shows is derived from these sources at runtime or by the scheduled aggregation job. There is no hand-maintained offline occasion list. adapters: pc-events-json, iran-holidays-json, shamsi-holidays-json, jalali-calendar-year-json, npm-official-hijri-months, persian-calendar-text, review-only.

tiers.official: Published by an Iranian state body, the official calendar authority, or a ministry.
tiers.unofficial: Independent Iranian calendar/news publishers. Useful corroboration, never the sole basis for a public holiday.
tiers.open-source: Public repositories and packages with a permissive licence that expose machine-readable data.
